## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-fascicle early-Qīng running commentary by **Zàishēn Hóngzàn** ([弘贊](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BC%98%E8%B4%8A), 1612–1686) of *Dǐnghúshān* on **Yúnqī Zhūhóng**'s 雲棲祩宏 ([袾宏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%A2%BE%E5%AE%8F), 1535–1615) *Shāmí lǜyí yàolüè* 沙彌律儀要略 — the late-Míng standard novice-monk handbook compiled by Zhūhóng from the *Shāmí shíjiè jīng* 沙彌十戒經 and other canonical sources. The internal title-line: *Púsàjiè dìzǐ Yúnqīsì shāmén Zhūhóng jí / Pútíxīn bǐqiū Dǐnghúshān shāmén Hóngzàn zhù* 菩薩戒弟子雲棲寺沙門　袾宏　輯／菩提心比丘鼎湖山沙門　弘贊　註.

A subsidiary appendix (*Jùjiè biànméng* 具戒便蒙) lists the 250 *bhikṣu*-precepts in standard *prātimokṣa* order — the four *pārājika*, thirteen *saṅghāvaśeṣa*, two *aniyata*, thirty *naissargika-pāyantika*, ninety *pāyantika*, four *pratideśanīya*, one hundred *śaikṣa*-rules, and seven dispute-settling rules — for ready reference.

**Abstract**

The *Zēngzhù* is **the principal Cáodòng / Dǐnghúshān contribution to the Qīng commentarial revival of Yúnqī Zhūhóng's novice-handbook tradition**, parallel to (but produced earlier than and independently of) Shūyù's *Shāmí lǜyí yàolüè shùyì* ([KR6k0228](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0228)) from the Bǎohuáshān–Zhāoqìng tradition. Composition is bracketed by Hóngzàn's mature scholarship at *Dǐnghú* (mid-1650s onward) and his death in 1686; `notBefore`–`notAfter` are set 1655–1686.
